  "has_chain": false,
  "tags": [

  "content_type": "exhortation",
  "chunks": [
    {
      "chunk_type": "opening",
      "arabic_text": "﴿ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ﴾",
      "translations": {
        "en": "Mischief has appeared"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "فَلاَ مُنْكِرٌ مُغَيِّرٌ، وَلاَ زَاجرٌ مُزْدَجِرٌ. أَفَبِهذَا تُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تُجَاوِرُوا اللهَ فِي دَارِ قُدْسِهِ، وَتَكُونُوا أَعَزَّ أَوْلِيَائِهِ عِنْدَهُ؟",
      "translations": {
        "en": "there is no one to oppose and change it, nor anyone to dissuade from it or desist from it. Do you, with these qualities, hope to secure abode in the purified neighbourhood of Allāh and to be regarded His staunch lovers?"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "هَيْهَاتَ! لاَ يُخْدَعُ اللهُ عَنْ جَنَّتِهِ، وَلاَ تُنَالُ مَرْضَاتُهُ إِلاَّ بِطَاعَتِهِ.",
      "translations": {
        "en": "Alas! Allāh cannot be deceived about His paradise and His will cannot be secured save by His obedience."
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "closing",
      "arabic_text": "لَعَنَ اللهُ الاْمِرِينَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ التَّارِكِينَ لَهُ، وَالنَّاهِينَ عَنِ المُنكَرِ الْعَامِلِينَ بِهِ!",
      "translations": {
        "en": "Allāh may curse those who advise good but they themselves avoid it, and those who desist others from evil but they themselves act upon it."
      }
    }
  ],
  "translations": {
    "en": {

        "زَاجرٌ مُزْدَجِرٌ": "One who dissuades and warns (from evil)",
        "دَارِ قُدْسِهِ": "His purified abode/neighbourhood",
        "أَعَزَّ أَوْلِيَائِهِ": "His staunchest/closest lovers",
